# before

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:before`](gmeow-before.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/before>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Allen BEFORE: this event ends strictly before the related event begins (a gap between them). Transitive. Inverse of [`gmeow:after`](gmeow-after.md). (= [time:intervalBefore](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalBefore) over the events' extents; TimeML TLINK relType BEFORE; TEO before.)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to qualitatively order two events when one ends strictly before the other begins, with a gap between them — the Allen BEFORE link, useful when exact dates are unknown but the ordering is.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it when the events abut with no gap (use [`gmeow:meets`](gmeow-meets.md)), overlap ([`gmeow:overlaps`](gmeow-overlaps.md)), or when a crisp date on each event already implies the order; this relates occurrences, not their bare extents.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:before`](gmeow-before.md) between two [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) occurrences; transitivity derives the sound closure. Read [`gmeow:after`](gmeow-after.md) as its inverse; the full Allen composition table is left to the solver (P12), not OWL.

### Examples

- ex:dinner [`gmeow:before`](gmeow-before.md) ex:concert.
